checks.descripcion: src/data.js y src/logic.js son módulos ES válidos
El código usa const y let, nunca var
data.js exporta TITLE y CATEGORIES con nombre, y por defecto 4 a 6 elementos con año y etiquetas
checks.cmd: cd {proyecto} && node --input-type=module -e "import assert from 'node:assert/strict'; import items, * as d from './src/data.js'; assert.equal(typeof d.TITLE, 'string'); const keys = Object.keys(d.CATEGORIES); assert.ok(keys.length >= 3 && keys.length <= 5); assert.ok(keys.includes('other')); assert.ok(Array.isArray(items) && items.length >= 4 && items.length <= 6); assert.ok(items.every(({ name, category, year, tags }) => typeof name === 'string' && keys.includes(category) && (year === null || Number.isInteger(year)) && Array.isArray(tags)));"

checks.descripcion: Las categorías y el título no son los del ejemplo Planetario
checks.cmd: cd {proyecto} && node --input-type=module -e "import assert from 'node:assert/strict'; import items, * as d from './src/data.js'; assert.ok(!Object.keys(d.CATEGORIES).some((key) => ['planet', 'star', 'nebula'].includes(key))); assert.ok(!d.TITLE.toLowerCase().includes('planetario'));"

checks.descripcion: getAllTags devuelve las etiquetas sin repetir y en orden alfabético
checks.cmd: cd {proyecto} && node --input-type=module -e "import assert from 'node:assert/strict'; import * as l from './src/logic.js'; const items = Object.freeze([Object.freeze({ id: 1, name: 'Urano', category: 'planet', year: 1781, tags: Object.freeze(['helado', 'gigante']) }), Object.freeze({ id: 2, name: 'Betelgeuse', category: 'star', year: null, tags: Object.freeze([]) }), Object.freeze({ id: 3, name: 'Ámbar', category: 'other', year: -500, tags: Object.freeze(['resina']) }), Object.freeze({ id: 4, name: 'Sirio B', category: 'star', year: 1862, tags: Object.freeze(['enana']) }), Object.freeze({ id: 5, name: 'Neptuno', category: 'planet', year: 1846, tags: Object.freeze(['helado']) })]); const names = (list) => list.map(({ name }) => name); assert.deepEqual(l.getAllTags(items), ['enana', 'gigante', 'helado', 'resina']); assert.deepEqual(l.getAllTags([]), []); assert.deepEqual(l.getAllTags([{ tags: ['órbita', 'luna', 'Marte'] }]), ['luna', 'Marte', 'órbita']);"

checks.descripcion: sortItems ordena por nombre por defecto y con 'name', sin modificar el array
checks.cmd: cd {proyecto} && node --input-type=module -e "import assert from 'node:assert/strict'; import * as l from './src/logic.js'; const items = Object.freeze([Object.freeze({ id: 1, name: 'Urano', category: 'planet', year: 1781, tags: Object.freeze(['helado', 'gigante']) }), Object.freeze({ id: 2, name: 'Betelgeuse', category: 'star', year: null, tags: Object.freeze([]) }), Object.freeze({ id: 3, name: 'Ámbar', category: 'other', year: -500, tags: Object.freeze(['resina']) }), Object.freeze({ id: 4, name: 'Sirio B', category: 'star', year: 1862, tags: Object.freeze(['enana']) }), Object.freeze({ id: 5, name: 'Neptuno', category: 'planet', year: 1846, tags: Object.freeze(['helado']) })]); const names = (list) => list.map(({ name }) => name); const expected = ['Ámbar', 'Betelgeuse', 'Neptuno', 'Sirio B', 'Urano']; assert.deepEqual(names(l.sortItems(items)), expected); assert.deepEqual(names(l.sortItems(items, 'name')), expected); assert.notEqual(l.sortItems(items), items);"

checks.descripcion: sortItems con 'year' pone primero el más antiguo y al final los que no tienen año
checks.cmd: cd {proyecto} && node --input-type=module -e "import assert from 'node:assert/strict'; import * as l from './src/logic.js'; const items = Object.freeze([Object.freeze({ id: 1, name: 'Urano', category: 'planet', year: 1781, tags: Object.freeze(['helado', 'gigante']) }), Object.freeze({ id: 2, name: 'Betelgeuse', category: 'star', year: null, tags: Object.freeze([]) }), Object.freeze({ id: 3, name: 'Ámbar', category: 'other', year: -500, tags: Object.freeze(['resina']) }), Object.freeze({ id: 4, name: 'Sirio B', category: 'star', year: 1862, tags: Object.freeze(['enana']) }), Object.freeze({ id: 5, name: 'Neptuno', category: 'planet', year: 1846, tags: Object.freeze(['helado']) })]); const names = (list) => list.map(({ name }) => name); assert.deepEqual(names(l.sortItems(items, 'year')), ['Ámbar', 'Urano', 'Neptuno', 'Sirio B', 'Betelgeuse']); const twoNull = [...items, { id: 6, name: 'X', category: 'other', year: null, tags: [] }]; assert.deepEqual(names(l.sortItems(twoNull, 'year')).slice(-2).toSorted(), ['Betelgeuse', 'X']);"

checks.descripcion: queryItems filtra por etiqueta y ordena, con valores por defecto
checks.cmd: cd {proyecto} && node --input-type=module -e "import assert from 'node:assert/strict'; import * as l from './src/logic.js'; const items = Object.freeze([Object.freeze({ id: 1, name: 'Urano', category: 'planet', year: 1781, tags: Object.freeze(['helado', 'gigante']) }), Object.freeze({ id: 2, name: 'Betelgeuse', category: 'star', year: null, tags: Object.freeze([]) }), Object.freeze({ id: 3, name: 'Ámbar', category: 'other', year: -500, tags: Object.freeze(['resina']) }), Object.freeze({ id: 4, name: 'Sirio B', category: 'star', year: 1862, tags: Object.freeze(['enana']) }), Object.freeze({ id: 5, name: 'Neptuno', category: 'planet', year: 1846, tags: Object.freeze(['helado']) })]); const names = (list) => list.map(({ name }) => name); assert.deepEqual(names(l.queryItems(items)), ['Ámbar', 'Betelgeuse', 'Neptuno', 'Sirio B', 'Urano']); assert.deepEqual(names(l.queryItems(items, { tag: 'helado' })), ['Neptuno', 'Urano']); assert.deepEqual(names(l.queryItems(items, { tag: 'helado', sortBy: 'year' })), ['Urano', 'Neptuno']); assert.deepEqual(names(l.queryItems(items, { sortBy: 'recent' })), ['Neptuno', 'Sirio B', 'Ámbar', 'Betelgeuse', 'Urano']); assert.deepEqual(l.queryItems(items, { tag: 'xyz' }), []);"

checks.descripcion: groupByCategory devuelve un objeto con la lista de elementos de cada categoría
checks.cmd: cd {proyecto} && node --input-type=module -e "import assert from 'node:assert/strict'; import * as l from './src/logic.js'; const items = Object.freeze([Object.freeze({ id: 1, name: 'Urano', category: 'planet', year: 1781, tags: Object.freeze(['helado', 'gigante']) }), Object.freeze({ id: 2, name: 'Betelgeuse', category: 'star', year: null, tags: Object.freeze([]) }), Object.freeze({ id: 3, name: 'Ámbar', category: 'other', year: -500, tags: Object.freeze(['resina']) }), Object.freeze({ id: 4, name: 'Sirio B', category: 'star', year: 1862, tags: Object.freeze(['enana']) }), Object.freeze({ id: 5, name: 'Neptuno', category: 'planet', year: 1846, tags: Object.freeze(['helado']) })]); const names = (list) => list.map(({ name }) => name); const groups = l.groupByCategory(items); assert.deepEqual(Object.keys(groups), ['planet', 'star', 'other']); assert.deepEqual(names(groups.planet), ['Urano', 'Neptuno']); assert.deepEqual(names(groups.star), ['Betelgeuse', 'Sirio B']); assert.deepEqual(names(groups.other), ['Ámbar']); assert.deepEqual(l.groupByCategory([]), {});"

checks.descripcion: findLastAdded devuelve el último elemento de la categoría, el último de todos con 'all' o undefined
checks.cmd: cd {proyecto} && node --input-type=module -e "import assert from 'node:assert/strict'; import * as l from './src/logic.js'; const items = Object.freeze([Object.freeze({ id: 1, name: 'Urano', category: 'planet', year: 1781, tags: Object.freeze(['helado', 'gigante']) }), Object.freeze({ id: 2, name: 'Betelgeuse', category: 'star', year: null, tags: Object.freeze([]) }), Object.freeze({ id: 3, name: 'Ámbar', category: 'other', year: -500, tags: Object.freeze(['resina']) }), Object.freeze({ id: 4, name: 'Sirio B', category: 'star', year: 1862, tags: Object.freeze(['enana']) }), Object.freeze({ id: 5, name: 'Neptuno', category: 'planet', year: 1846, tags: Object.freeze(['helado']) })]); const names = (list) => list.map(({ name }) => name); assert.equal(l.findLastAdded(items, 'star').name, 'Sirio B'); assert.equal(l.findLastAdded(items, 'other').name, 'Ámbar'); assert.equal(l.findLastAdded(items).name, 'Neptuno'); assert.equal(l.findLastAdded(items, 'all').name, 'Neptuno'); assert.equal(l.findLastAdded(items, 'nebula'), undefined); assert.equal(l.findLastAdded([]), undefined);"
